question: Let $\vec{a}=\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$, $\vec{p}=3\vec{a}$ and $\vec{q}=-2\vec{a}$. Compare $\vec{p}$ and $\vec{q}$ with respect to parallelism, relative direction and magnitude.
explanation:
Step 1: Expression of the vectors
\(\vec{p}=3\hat{i}-6\hat{j}+6\hat{k},\qquad\vec{q}=-2\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-4\hat{k}\)
Step 2: Relationship between $\vec{p}$ and $\vec{q}$
Since $\vec{p}=3\vec{a}$ and $\vec{q}=-2\vec{a}$,
\(\vec{q}=-\frac{2}{3}\vec{p}\)
Therefore, the vectors are parallel. The negative scalar shows that they point in opposite directions.
Step 3: Comparison of magnitudes
\(|\vec{p}|=3|\vec{a}|,\qquad|\vec{q}|=2|\vec{a}|\)
Hence, $|\vec{p}|:|\vec{q}|=3:2$.
Final Answer
$\vec{p}$ and $\vec{q}$ are parallel in opposite directions, and their magnitudes are in the ratio $3:2$.

options.A: $\vec{p}$ and $\vec{q}$ are equal and have magnitude ratio $1:1$.
options.B: $\vec{p}$ and $\vec{q}$ are perpendicular, with magnitude ratio $3:2$.
options.C: $\vec{p}$ and $\vec{q}$ are parallel in the same direction, with magnitude ratio $3:2$.
options.D: $\vec{q}=-\frac{2}{3}\vec{p}$, so $\vec{p}$ and $\vec{q}$ are parallel in opposite directions and $|\vec{p}|:|\vec{q}|=3:2$.
